terminals.description: filter structure option specifies the order of the IIR cascade filter. 0 IIR 2nd Order—Returns IIR second-order filter stages. 1 IIR 4th Order—Returns IIR fourth-order filter stages. 2 Auto Select (default)—Returns either IIR second-order or IIR fourth-order filter stages according to the type. terminals.description: IIR filter specifications is the cluster containing design parameters for an IIR filter.

terminals.name: Topology
terminals.description: Topology determines the design type of the filter. 0 Off 1 Butterworth 2 Chebyshev 3 Inverse Chebyshev 4 Elliptic 5 Bessel

terminals.name: Type
terminals.description: Type specifies the passband of the filter according to the following values. 0 Lowpass 1 Highpass 2 Bandpass Functions 4260 ni.com 3 Bandstop

terminals.name: Order
terminals.description: Order is the filter order. If Order ≤ 0, the filter uses optional IIR filter specification to compute the order.

terminals.name: Lower Fc
terminals.description: Lower Fc is the low cutoff frequency and must observe the Nyquist criterion. The Nyquist criterion is 0 < fl < 0.5fs, where fl is the cutoff frequency, and fs is the sampling frequency. If Lower Fc is less than zero or greater than half the sampling frequency, the VI sets the signal out waveform to be empty and returns an error. The default is 100.

terminals.name: Upper Fc
terminals.description: Upper Fc is the high cutoff frequency. This parameter is ignored when Type is 0 (lowpass) or 1 (highpass).

terminals.name: PB Ripple
terminals.description: PB Ripple must be greater than zero, and you must express it in decibels. If PB Ripple is less than or equal to zero, the VI sets the signal out waveform to be empty and returns an error. The default is 1.0.

terminals.name: SB Attenuation
terminals.description: SB Attenuation specifies the stopband attenuation. SB Attenuation must be greater than zero and expressed in decibels. If SB Attenuation is less than or equal to zero, the VI sets the signal output to zero or an empty array and returns an error. The default is 60.0.

terminals.description: optional IIR filter specifications is a cluster containing information necessary to compute the order of an IIR filter.

terminals.name: window parameter
terminals.description: window parameter specifies the beta parameter for a Kaiser window, the standard deviation for a Gaussian window, and the ratio, s, of the main lobe to the side lobe for a Dolph-Chebyshev window. If window is any other window, this VI ignores this input. The default value of window parameter is NaN, which sets beta to 0 for a Kaiser window, the standard deviation to 0.2 for a Gaussian window, and s to 60 for a Dolph-Chebyshev window.

entries.name: Initializing the Point By Point VIs
entries.description: Using the initialize parameter, you can reset the internal state of Point By Point VIs without interrupting the continuous flow of data or computation. You can reset a VI in response to events such as the following: • A user changing the value of a parameter • The application generating a specific event or reaching a threshold For example, the Value Has Changed PtByPt VI can respond to change events such as the following: • Receiving the input data • Detecting the change • Generating a Boolean T
